My Story

Hi, I'm Tanya Mishra, a graphic designer based in Delhi NCR. Design, for me, has never been about filling a template — it's about giving a brand a face people remember. Whether it's a perfume bottle catching the last light of the evening or a streetwear model owning a stark black-and-white frame, I chase the same thing every time: an image that makes someone stop scrolling.

My work sits at the intersection of editorial fashion and everyday branding. I've built moody, cinematic poster series for a Milan-inspired label, designed a full botanical identity for a skincare brand from the logo up, and shaped a streetwear world around bold type and confident silhouettes. Each project starts the same way — by understanding the story a brand wants to tell — and ends with visuals that carry that story consistently across every post, poster and page.

I work mainly in Canva, alongside Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma, moving between them depending on what a project needs: fast, polished social creatives one day, a detailed brand system the next. I care as much about the small things — type pairing, spacing, the exact shade of a colour — as I do about the big creative idea, because I've learned that the two are never really separate.

Outside client work, I'm just as drawn to storytelling and worldbuilding — building characters, settings and visual mood boards for fantasy and romance universes. It's the same instinct at play: creating a world someone wants to stay in, whether that's a fictional realm or a brand's Instagram feed.

I'm currently available for freelance projects, graphic design roles and creative collaborations. If you have a brand, a launch or an idea that needs a distinct visual voice, I'd love to hear about it — whatever the brief, I'll make it thoughtful, consistent and genuinely unforgettable.

Selected work

Project 1Carla Braga

Vintage elegance meets bold fashion imagery. Black heels, lace stockings and warm golden tones create a nostalgic editorial mood, with oversized serif lettering and French text that follows the contours of the photograph.

Project 2Maison Vérane

A luxury perfume poster series with minimal layouts, refined typography and a strong focus on the fragrance bottle. Dramatic shadows, monochrome tones and muted green create three distinct moods with one consistent identity.

Project 3Lumora Skincare

A botanical skincare identity in olive greens, delicate leaf details and elegant type. Includes the logo, product launch creative and informative layouts that highlight the brand's nature-inspired approach.

Project 4NOIR Streetwear

A streetwear poster series exploring bold typography, monochrome styling and editorial layouts. Oversized lettering and layered model cutouts capture NOIR's confident fashion identity.
